company.name: Krishna Infosys
company.operationalAddress: 15 & 16, 1st Floor, Swastik House, Near Stadium Circle, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad – 380009
about: Krishna Infosys is an ELV turnkey consulting and systems integration firm delivering security, communication, AV, networking and automation programmes pan-India.
We combine design, supply, installation, commissioning and AMC support under ISO 9001:2015-aligned processes, with 2,100+ projects and 850+ clients delivered since 2001.

jobs.summary: Own ELV programme delivery — schedules, coordination, quality gates and client communication from kick-off to handover.
description: You will lead end-to-end delivery of Extra Low Voltage programmes across security, communication, AV, networking and related systems.
The role sits between clients, site teams and internal engineering — keeping scope, time and quality aligned from survey through commissioning.
You should be comfortable on live sites, reading drawings/BOQs, and driving vendors and technicians to a clean handover.
responsibilities: Plan and track project milestones, resources and site logistics
Coordinate design, procurement, installation and commissioning stages
Run client meetings, progress reporting and issue escalation
Enforce quality checks, documentation and as-built discipline
Support handover, training and AMC transition where required
requirements: 5+ years in ELV, security, electrical or related project delivery
Strong site coordination and stakeholder communication skills
Familiarity with CCTV, access control, fire alarm or structured cabling projects
Willingness to travel across project locations in India
Diploma/degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience

jobs.summary: Develop opportunities across security, communication, AV and networking. Convert surveys into clear proposals with the engineering team.
description: You will build and convert a pipeline of ELV opportunities across corporate, industrial, healthcare and other verticals.
Success means structured discovery, accurate scoping with engineering, and proposals that clients can approve without ambiguity.
Field presence in Ahmedabad and surrounding markets is expected.
responsibilities: Identify and qualify leads across target verticals
Conduct site visits and requirement discovery with clients
Work with pre-sales/engineering on BOQ and proposal inputs
Own follow-ups, negotiations and order closure
Maintain CRM hygiene and weekly pipeline reporting
requirements: 3+ years B2B sales experience, preferably in ELV, IT, electrical or security
Confident communicator with decision-makers on site and in offices
Basic technical curiosity for CCTV, access, networking and related systems
Self-driven field routine and disciplined follow-up habits
Valid driving licence preferred

jobs.summary: Lead design reviews, BOQs and commissioning for CCTV, access, fire, PA and structured cabling programmes.
description: You will be a senior technical owner for ELV designs and commissioning quality.
The role mixes desk design (architecture, BOQ, reviews) with on-site validation and troubleshooting.
You will mentor technicians and protect engineering standards across live projects.
responsibilities: Produce and review system architectures, schedules and BOQs
Validate installation quality and lead commissioning tests
Resolve technical issues across CCTV, access, fire, PA and cabling
Support pre-sales with feasible designs and risk notes
Document configurations, test results and handover packs
requirements: 4+ years hands-on ELV or low-voltage systems experience
Strong practical knowledge in at least two of: CCTV, access, fire alarm, PA, structured cabling
Ability to read drawings and produce clear technical notes
Calm problem-solving under site pressure
Diploma/degree in electronics, electrical, instrumentation or related field

jobs.summary: Install, terminate, test and service ELV systems with clean documentation and professional site discipline.
description: You will execute installation and service work for ELV systems under engineer/project guidance.
Clean terminations, honest testing and tidy documentation matter as much as speed.
Most work is on client sites across Ahmedabad and project locations.
responsibilities: Install devices, lay/terminate cables and dress racks to standard
Perform basic configuration, testing and fault finding
Follow site safety and client access rules
Update job sheets, photos and material consumption records
Support AMC visits and corrective maintenance when assigned
requirements: 2+ years experience in CCTV, access, fire, PA or structured cabling installation
Comfortable with hand tools, testers and height/site work
Basic understanding of IP networking is an advantage
Reliable, punctual and neat workmanship
ITI/diploma preferred; strong practical skill considered

jobs.summary: Support billing, collections, vendor accounts and project commercial tracking with accuracy and speed.
description: You will keep project and company accounts moving — invoices, follow-ups, vendor bills and basic reconciliations.
Accuracy and turnaround time directly affect project cash flow and vendor trust.
This is an office-based role in Ahmedabad with cross-team coordination.
responsibilities: Prepare and track client invoices and collections
Process vendor bills and maintain payable records
Support project cost tracking and basic MIS
Coordinate with banks for routine payment operations
Maintain organised digital and physical account files
requirements: 3+ years accounts experience in a services or trading environment
Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting software
Strong Excel hygiene and attention to detail
Clear communication for client/vendor follow-ups
Commerce graduate preferred
